purpose: Describe the desired assessment movement precisely enough for Motion Lab generation and visual verification without conflating demonstration with compensation scoring.

startPosition: knees extended but not forcefully locked
arms overhead with upper arms near the ears
phaseSequence: controlled descent through the owner-reviewed MID geometry
hold the exact bottom pose for 0.18 seconds
controlled ascent through the same MID geometry in reverse
return to the exact overhead standing position
contactConstraints: generated bilateral leg IK owns planted-foot contact during loaded motion
Coach playback inserts grounded intermediate solve samples between named phases
no jump or heel-release phase is authored
trajectoryConstraints: pelvis descends and travels posteriorly using the existing owner-reviewed squat reference geometry
knees flex with hips and ankles rather than driving the motion alone
knees track in the same general direction as the feet
ascent mirrors the same geometry as BOTTOM -> MID -> START
both upper-arm shoulder-to-elbow segments point overhead in world space rather than copying a source rig local Euler axis
finish returns to the same overhead standing pose
rigSemanticConstraints: identify the actual loaded left upper-arm bone and its forearm child
identify the actual loaded right upper-arm bone and its forearm child
interpret overhead as a body-segment direction, not as a fixed local X/Y/Z rotation copied from another armature
solve shoulder-to-elbow direction against the target rig geometry before compiling the clip
preserve the original target avatar rest pose after compilation
visualAcceptanceCheckpoints: arms do not pass through torso or head because of rig-axis mismatch
bilateral foot grounding between as well as at named phases
return to exact overhead top position

assessmentObservation.importantBoundary: These are observation targets for a separate pose-analysis/scoring layer. The Motion Spec is the reference demonstration and does not diagnose causes or assign production severity thresholds.

calibrationPolicy.provisionalField: exact arms-by-ears spacing after semantic world-up solve
calibrationPolicy.ownerAction: First verify the semantic solver keeps each shoulder-to-elbow segment overhead without crossing through the body. Then use Pose Editor only for small owner-approved spacing/twist refinement; do not reintroduce guessed source-rig Euler rotations.

retargetLesson.previousMistake: The canonical Mixamo upper-arm local-X rotation was copied onto the Avaturn upper-arm bone after name remapping only.
retargetLesson.whyItFailed: Bone names can match semantically while their local coordinate axes differ. The same Euler value can therefore produce a different physical direction and an arm path through the torso.
retargetLesson.systemUpgrade: Describe important limb placement with semantic body-segment directions and solve those directions from the actual loaded armature geometry.

sourceNotes: Movement intent is adapted from the repository's existing Overhead Squat Assessment checklist.

Lower-body phase geometry intentionally reuses the current synthesized squat engineering reference so this test isolates whether adding a new movement contract and overhead constraint composes correctly.
Upper-arm placement now uses target-rig semantic direction instead of a copied local-axis angle.
